title: Golden calcite alabaster altar of unknown origin

tellings.quote: that altar in front of you is made out of golden kisite Alabaster right and they don't even know where it came from

plain: An altar near Lake Van in eastern Turkey is made of golden calcite alabaster, a soft, glowing stone, and nobody knows where that stone came from. Matt LaCroix, a researcher of ancient sites, tells Michels this as they stand before it, without naming a source, as one more puzzle about who built the region's old sites.
